The Business Analyst serves as the analytical engine of the North America Business Planning team. Working side-by-side with our Industry Business Planners, you will turn data into insight, transform spreadsheets into decisions, and help shape the strategies that drive revenue growth and market share gains across our industry portfolio. Rather than owning a single industry vertical, you will work horizontally partnering with every Industry Business Planner on the team to deliver the market analyses, financial models, and competitive intelligence that fuel their go-to-market (GTM) plans.

This role is purpose-built for early-career professionals who are eager to learn and excited to apply modern tools — including AI, machine learning, generative AI, and AI-assisted coding — to real business problems. You will sharpen your strategic thinking, build a foundation in B2B enterprise software strategy, and develop the analytical, technical, and storytelling skills that power senior planning roles. Enterprise software experience is helpful but not required; curiosity, analytical horsepower, and a builder’s mindset are.

  • Partner with Industry Business Planners across all verticals — including Automotive, Industrial Equipment, Aerospace & Defense, High-Tech, and others — to provide analytical support, market research, and financial modeling
  • Build and maintain macroeconomic, market, and competitive analyses that inform 1- and 3-year strategic plans across the territory
  • Support the annual sales planning exercise: territory analysis, account scoring, target setting, capacity modeling, and revenue plan build-out across all sales distribution channels
  • Develop financial models and tools to support revenue planning, performance analysis, and other items to improve insights and business decisions
  • Design and maintain dashboards, automations, and analytical tools that scale the productivity of the Business Planning team
  • Apply AI, machine learning, and generative AI tools to accelerate research, automate repetitive workflows, and surface insights at greater speed and scale
  • Use AI-assisted coding (Python, SQL, scripting) to prototype analytical tools, automations, and data workflows — even if you are still learning to code, AI copilots will be your collaborator from day one
  • Conduct ongoing competitor intelligence: monitor competitor moves, win/loss patterns, pricing dynamics, and market positioning; package findings into clear narratives for Sales and leadership
  • Support the identification of priority accounts and OEM/supply-chain ecosystem networks that anchor our growth ambitions
  • Synthesize macroeconomic, industry, and account-level data into briefings, decks, and recommendations for Sales Directors, Industry Business Planners, and senior leadership
  • Contribute to the feedback loop with global Market Intelligence and Industry teams, surfacing North America–specific dynamics and trends
  • Proactively propose enhancements to our planning processes, methods, and content — fresh ideas welcome

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Business, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Data Analytics, Statistics, or similar)
  • 5–8 years of experience in business analysis, strategy, finance, market research, sales operations, or a related analytical role preferred
  • Master’s degree or MBA is a plus, but not required
  • Demonstrated interest in AI, machine learning, analytics, or modern data tooling — through coursework, side projects, certifications, or prior work — is highly valued

  • Work closely with the sales team to provide specific insights, training, and support

  • Assess ecosystem capacity to hit financial targets

  • Creative and Strategic skills welcome! IBPs analyze 3DS market positioning and competitive dynamics to influence tactics how we win.  The IBP needs to transform ideas into action, with a grounding in what is achievable

  • Strong financial and analytical skills. You are not a stranger to an Excel spreadsheet, intuiting what data you need, and a knack for finding it
  • Experience in B2B preferred.  You understand the B2B sales cycle and marketing tactics needed to be effective when selling to corporate clients
  • You are unafraid to roll up your sleeves and learn the ins and outs of the product portfolio and customers. 
  • Great networker who can to build a strong network within the internal ecosystem.  You know how to navigate the corporate ecosystem and build relationships in order to get things done
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field
  • MBA Preferred

As a member of the Cloud Engineering and Operations Department, you’ll be part of the infrastructure team responsible for enabling the deployment and ongoing operational excellence of Medidata’s state-of-the-art production data centers. Our infrastructure is growing, and we typically handle multiple design, procurement, ordering, and deployment projects simultaneously. You will be an integral part of these projects and help our company continue its successful global expansion.


The Staff Network Engineer is responsible for all functions relating to the operations and support of our hosting network technology infrastructure. This engineer must be able to work in a highly dynamic environment, either individually or as part of a team.  It is required to perform various levels of projects, support initiatives and help to prioritize the workloads while following our Agile project management methodology.


This position is responsible for supporting all network-based activities as part of the Medidata Clinical Cloud Platform. This includes planning and installation of new hardware, monitoring LAN/WAN/Internet circuits uptime and bandwidth while ensuring high network availability, resolving complex client related problems, and designing and implementing all VPN/WAN links within Medidata and with external clients. 
 

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for following the vision and strategy for Medidata’s hosting network operations
  • Responsible for operating Medidata's customer facing data communications systems

  • Coordinates procurement, implementations, and troubleshooting efforts with vendors
  • Responsible for leading all project implementations requiring network resources
  • Conducts project planning, cost analysis and vendor comparisons

  • Create/Maintain network support documentation while constantly improving existing processes and procedures
    Provides training and assists with proposal writing

Your Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of total experience with at least 3+ years hands-on experience  in network engineering, preferably with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • CCNP certification or equivalent required
  • CCIE certification preferred
  • At least 2+ years of Programming skills in any one of these Python, Ansible, Go preferred
  • Experience supporting a 24x7 Operational environment, requiring shift support
     


Your Competencies:

  • Experience in designing scalable cloud and data center using Private/public cloud technology and managing enterprise-class routers, switches, firewalls and F5 LTM/GTM
  • In-depth knowledge of network security protocols, including firewalls, VXLAN, L2VPN, L3VPN, IDS/IPS, and DDoS mitigation techniques.
  • High proficiency with routing protocols (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP), VPN and various firewall technologies and vendors.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • Expert understanding of external L2 / L3 fabric connectivity and experience in L2 / L3 switching Architecture design
    Solid understanding of network virtualization 
  • Expertise in containerized networking, CNI plugins i.e. Calico,Cilium...
  • Expertise in defining network policy, external connectivity to Kubernetes cluster.
  • Excellent knowledge of (DDI) DNS and DHCP, IP address management (IPAM)
  • Hands on and troubleshooting experience of Spine-Leaf architecture CISCO Nexus- N9K or equivalent
  • Experience with ingress/egress and service mesh (linkerD or istio) implementation and management
  • Work closely with engineers, QA, project managers throughout the software lifecycle in optimally delivering outstanding, large scale systems
  • Provide 24 x 7 production support on a rotating basis.

Additional Skills:
 

  • Knowledge of SD-WAN solution deployment.
  • Experience with L4-L7- load balancing, firewalls, etc. will be an additional advantage.
  • Expert experience with configuring and deploying enterprise-class networks including the following products: Cisco Nexus/Catalyst Product Lines
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

Dans le domaine de la simulation numérique de phénomènes physiques, un nombre croissant de travaux de recherche se concentre sur l’intégration de méthodes d’intelligence artificielle, et en particulier de machine learning, afin d’améliorer les simulations classiques ou d’accélérer significativement les calculs. La disponibilité croissante de données issues de simulations, qu’elles soient synthétiques ou réelles, a fortement contribué à l’émergence de ces approches, qui se distinguent souvent par leur efficacité en termes de temps de calcul.

Certaines de ces méthodes permettent aujourd’hui de prédire avec précision des régimes stationnaires pour différents types de phénomènes physiques et ce, en un temps nettement réduit par rapport aux méthodes numériques traditionnelles. En revanche, la simulation de phénomènes physiques dynamiques, notamment la prédiction de champs 3D ou de séries temporelles longues, reste un défi pour les approches basées sur les réseaux de neurones et apparaît encore moins mature.

Il est donc essentiel d’étudier et de comparer les méthodes récentes les plus prometteuses pour la simulation dynamique via machine learning. L’objectif est de développer des modèles numériques capables de dépasser les limitations actuelles et d’ouvrir de nouvelles perspectives dans la simulation numérique. Les domaines d'application sont extrêmement variés. On peut par exemple citer la simulation de structures, la simulation de fluides ou le transfert thermique. À terme, les méthodes développées pourront être intégrées dans la conception et l’exploitation de jumeaux virtuels de systèmes complexes.

- Au travers des études et prototypes réalisés, vous élaborerez des recommandations technologiques et vous accompagnerez leur transfert vers les équipes de développement produit,
- Démontrer l'applicabilité et l'usage des composants dans des scénarii adaptés aux besoins de la R&D et de nos partenaires,
- Établir/maintenir des collaborations avec nos partenaires industriels et académiques,

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. The Senior Director of Strategy will play a critical role in shaping the future of our multi-product platform. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in product strategy within the technology and/or life sciences space, a sharp understanding of market and customer dynamics, and a strong ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

Strategic Planning & Vision:

  • For a portfolio of products within scope, define strategic priorities over the next 1-3 years based on unmet customer needs, market and competitive dynamics and 3DS / Medidata vision
  • Co-own the strategy of a portfolio of products with the Product Leads
  • Assess build/buy/partner approach to compete effectively and accelerate strategic priorities as required
  • Lead primary and secondary market research, including interpretation of output and final recommendations

Translate Strategy into Executable Roadmap

  • Exposure to Life Sciences industry - including clinical trial ecosystem, regulatory environment, and healthcare tech landscape - or B2B software strongly preferred.
